Brand: Antec
Category: Internal Components > Internal Power Supplies

## Features
Includes, Universal Input, Active Power Factor Correction (PFC), with industrial grade protection by preventing damage from- short circuits, over voltage, over current; Connectors feature, EPS 8pin(4+4) and 1- 6pin PCI-E, 1 - 20+4 MoBo, 5 SATA, 4 Molex and 1 floppy. Includes 80mm low noise cooling fan.; Help save the environment with this EarthWatts Green PSU, it comes WITHOUT the AC cord so use the one you are upgrading from!; Antec always uses Continuous Power for all labels and model names. Antec never uses Peak Power. When buying your new power supply, make sure to distinguish Continuous Power from Peak Power, and remember to choose a brand you can trust.

## Specifications

## Details
Model: EA-430D GREEN. UPC: 191120083650 761345274340

## Description
Get the power you need and the low electric bill you want with Antec’s EA-430D Green! Antec introduces one of the most efficient power supplies on the planet, the EA-430D Green, which delivers 430 watts of reliable, Continuous Power while meeting the Bronze level of performance from 80 PLUS, the most widely recognized independent standard in power supply efficiency. Two +12V output circuits provide added system stability, and industrial-grade protection circuitry prevents damage resulting from short circuits, power overloads, over voltage and other electrical dangers. Plus, the EA-430D Green boasts Universal Input to automatically connect with any power grid in the world and a quiet 80mm fan to keep your system running cool. “Go green” with Antec’s EA-430D Green: an efficient, cost-effective power supply solution that lets you power your equipment, save money and protect the environment. To help protect the environment even more, this EA430D does not come with an AC cord, just re-use the original you are upgrading from!

# Antec EarthWatts EA-430D Green Power Supply User Manual

Model: EA-430D GREEN

## 1. Introduction

This manual provides essential information for the installation, operation, and maintenance of your Antec EarthWatts EA-430D Green Power Supply. Designed for efficiency and reliability, this 430-watt power supply meets 80 PLUS BRONZE certification standards, ensuring energy savings and reduced heat output. Please read this manual thoroughly before installation to ensure proper setup and safe operation.

...

Always observe the following safety precautions to prevent injury or damage to your equipment:

- Ensure the power supply is disconnected from the AC outlet before installation or maintenance.
- Do not open the power supply casing. High voltages are present inside, and there are no user-serviceable parts.
- Install the power supply in a well-ventilated area to prevent overheating.
- Use only the provided or compatible cables. Incorrect cable usage can cause damage.
- Protect the power supply from moisture and extreme temperatures.
- This power supply is designed for use with personal computers. Do not use it for other applications.

## 3. Product Features

The Antec EarthWatts EA-430D Green Power Supply offers a range of features designed for optimal performance and energy efficiency:

- Continuous Power: Delivers 430 watts of reliable, continuous power.
- 80 PLUS BRONZE Certified: Achieves at least 82% energy efficiency, reducing electricity consumption and heat generation.
- Universal Input: Automatically connects to any power grid worldwide (90-240 VAC) without manual adjustment.
- Advanced Protection Circuitry: Industrial-grade protection against short circuits, power overloads, overvoltage, and other electrical hazards.
- Quiet Cooling: Features an 80mm low-noise cooling fan for efficient heat dissipation.
- Dual +12V Output Circuits: Provides enhanced system stability and safety.
- Active Power Factor Correction (PFC): Ensures a power factor of up to 99%, improving efficiency and reducing transmission losses.
- Comprehensive Connectors: Includes 20+4 pin ATX, 8-pin (4+4) EPS, 6-pin PCI-E, 5 SATA, 4 Molex, and 1 Floppy connector for broad compatibility.

## 9. Warranty and Support

The Antec EarthWatts EA-430D Green PC Power Supply is backed by a three-year manufacturer's limited warranty. For warranty claims or technical support, please visit the official Antec website or contact their customer service department. Keep your proof of purchase for warranty validation.

For additional resources, you may refer to the official User Guide (PDF).
